historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_3yr_cagr, cross-checked against FY2026 revenue guidance of 3-4%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (4.6%) is less than half the revenue 5yr CAGR (10.3%): equity is suppressed by $2.2bn of buybacks FY21-25, and the 5yr revenue CAGR starts from COVID-hit FY2020. Revenue has been flat at $3.7-4.1bn since FY2021, which is the more honest anchor.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - withholding taxes - interest income): FY2020 ~348, FY2022 85.3, FY2023 414, FY2024 401, FY2025 268.5. The 46.6% 3yr owner-FCF CAGR is a base effect off the FY2022 working-capital trough and is not a growth rate. EPS 5yr CAGR is omitted: FY2020 EPS of $22.41 contains a ~$1.4bn tax benefit from an IP intra-entity transfer. SBC has grown faster than revenue (FY22 3.6% -> FY25 4.6% of revenue), so an increasing share of reported FCF is paid for in stock. 2026-11-19 update: annual CAGRs unchanged (no new fiscal year). 9M-26 revenue +4.1% year on year; Q4-26 guide ($1.00-1.02bn) is 3-5% below Q4-25's $1,047.6m.

scenario_narratives.base: Align lands its cut FY2026 guide (revenue $4.11-4.13bn, +2.1%; Systems & Services -8-9%) with owner FCF near $400m, held down by legal/VAT charges, restructuring and a ~$100m+ deferred-revenue unwind. FY2027 grows only ~3%: Clear Aligner volume is healthy (case shipments +6.6% in Q3-26, record doctor submitters, the first North America orthodontist uptick in six quarters) but revenue per case is falling (-2.4% in Q3-26), the scanner line is still shrinking and the Q4-26 exit rate is below the prior year. Growth then runs mid-single digits on international, teen and DSO volume. Adjusted EBITDA margin rebuilds to ~26% by FY2029, in line with the preliminary +100bp FY27 target that the incoming CEO has yet to endorse, but not back to the ~29-30% peak because price competition caps it. Owner FCF margin ~13-14% at maturity.
scenario_narratives.bull: The Q3-26 North America uptick is the start of a category recovery: clear aligners resume taking share from wires and brackets in under-penetrated APAC and EMEA, Invisalign First and DSO penetration broaden the market, and AI ClinCheck plus DSP/pay-per-scan subscriptions turn the iTero base back into a growth funnel. Jennifer Davis and the Elliott-refreshed board use the operating-model review to remove structural cost, and margins return to the prior-cycle ~29% adj EBITDA. Revenue grows 7-8% at the peak before fading to 3.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Align's pricing power erodes: with the SmartTrack materials patents found invalid for lack of enablement, lower-cost competitors (Envista Spark, Straumann ClearCorrect/Smartee, Angelalign) take the value tier, North America adult retail stays soft with self-pay patients deferring treatment, and iTero capital-equipment demand does not recover. Align defends volume with price, so FY2027 revenue is flat and growth settles at ~2%; a first-time outsider CEO inherits a strategic review under activist pressure and the cost resets do not outrun price. Adjusted EBITDA margin slides to ~21.5%; recurring restructuring, the revived City Smiles antitrust class action and jurisdictional tax hits (UK VAT) become a feature, not one-offs.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Align is valued as a mature, cash-generative category leader whose growth algorithm has broken: the model does not credit a return to the historical 15-20% growth, charges SBC and equity-award withholding taxes as real costs, strips interest on the $1.1bn cash pile, and rebuilds margins from components rather than carrying FY2025's restructuring-depressed or H1-26's deferred-revenue-flattered cash flow forward.
key_risks_to_valuation: Share loss at the value tier to Spark, ClearCorrect/Smartee and Chinese aligners now that the SmartTrack materials patents have been found invalid (post-trial motions and appeal pending) -- the bear margin path
North America discretionary demand and patient-financing rates; one quarter of orthodontist growth after six of decline is not yet a trend
Deferred revenue has fallen ~$265m from the FY2023 peak ($98m in 9M-26). Year 1 is calibrated to it; if the unwind persists beyond FY2026 the base FCF is overstated by ~$50-100m/yr
Revenue per case fell 2.4% year on year in Q3-26; a faster mix shift to lower-priced products would cut growth below case volume for longer than the base assumes

City Smiles antitrust class action revived by the Ninth Circuit (2026-10-05): treble-damages exposure, unquantified, not in the bridge. Only the accrued UK VAT ($43.1m) and Snow settlement ($32.7m) are deducted
CEO transition (Jennifer Davis, 2026-12-31) and the Elliott-prompted operating-model review: FY2027 guidance is deferred, and the ~100bp margin target the base relies on is the outgoing team's
Recurring 'one-time' charges (restructuring every year FY2022-FY2026, UK VAT) -- the base keeps ~0.5pp of margin for them
Terminal value is capped at 15x FCF in base; the valuation is sensitive to WACC given an equity-only capital structure
valuation_philosophy.unchanged_assumptions: Deliberately left as in the 2026-09-25 build: base growth FY29 onward and all margins FY27 onward (management reiterated ~100bp of FY27 margin expansion; would move on the new CEO's FY27 guide or the operating-model review outcome); cash tax path (9M-26 ETR 23.9% vs 24% modelled); wc_capture -10%; WACC 10%, terminal growth and cap multiples (10-year UST and the capital structure are unchanged); scenario weights; flat share count; the 15% hurdle.

inputs.share_count_basis: 70.487m shares on issue at 2026-10-30 (Q3-26 10-Q cover) plus ~0.02m treasury-method dilution (Q3-26 diluted 71.015m vs basic 70.993m). The cover count is after the ~0.2m shares / $30m repurchased in October 2026, so the same $30m is taken off the 2026-09-30 cash balance. Held FLAT: SBC plus equity-award withholding taxes are fully expensed in the flows, so diluting as well would double-count. Align is a funded repurchaser ($466m FY25, $201m 9M-26, up to $300m guided for Q4-26, $600m left on the April 2025 authorisation), so the flat count is paid for in cash.
inputs.sbc_source: SEC XBRL FY2025 10-K: ShareBasedCompensation 185.87 (cash-flow add-back) + PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation 20.39 (financing). Align publishes no combined reconciliation figure, so the two lines are summed. 9M-26 (Q3-26 10-Q): 125.5 + 29.2 = 154.8 (5.0% of 9M revenue 3,111.0); SBC alone is down 11% year on year. TTM to Q3-26: 169.8 + 29.4 = 199.2 (4.8% of TTM revenue 4,158.6).
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. 10-year UST ~4.3% + beta ~1.15 x 5.0% ERP = ~10.0%. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity. Observed 5y beta (~1.6-1.7) is inflated by the 2021-22 bubble-and-bust; 1.15 reflects a discretionary-consumer medical device with an 80%+ category share. One WACC across all scenarios -- risk is carried in the bear flows and a 25% bear weight, not a premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases (liabilities $120.8m at 2026-06-30; lease cost ~$43m/yr) are expensed inside operating income and therefore inside EBITDA; lease liabilities are NOT in net debt. One treatment, charged once. No finance leases outstanding.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (routing row 1: operating company, medical device / consumer-healthcare with a software-and-scanner ecosystem); same model as the 2026-09-25 build. UPDATE of 2026-11-19 for the Q3-26 10-Q and the 2026-10-28 guidance cut -- see reconciliation. OWNER FCF FY2025 (fy0) = reported FCF 490.8 - SBC incl. withholding taxes 206.3 - interest income 16.1 = 268.5 (6.7% margin), a trough year. 9M-26 owner FCF = reported 415.2 (OCF 526.7 - capex 111.5) - SBC and withholding taxes 154.8 - interest income 14.8 = 245.7; TTM to Q3-26 = 383.9 (9.2% of revenue). INTEREST INCOME stripped because net cash is >1x the owner-FCF base. YEAR 1 (FY2026) IS CALIBRATED TO CASH, NOT TO THE NON-GAAP MARGIN: with three quarters reported, FY26 owner FCF is tracking ~$390-400m. Pre-SBC adjusted EBITDA is ~24.5% (9M-26: operating income 465.1 + D&A 136.1 + SBC 125.5 = 726.8, 23.4%, with $76m of legal/VAT charges and $17m restructuring inside; Q4 guide ~20% GAAP operating margin), but deferred revenue fell $98m in 9M-26 (1,261.8 -> 1,162.1) and the engine's growth-linked working-capital line cannot carry an unwind, so the base year-1 margin is set at 21.0% to land the cash figure. The $76m of legal/VAT charges are accrued, not paid, and sit in the equity bridge instead. From FY27 the base returns to the unchanged path (24.5% -> 26%), consistent with management's preliminary ~100bp FY27 operating-margin expansion; the mature base margin keeps ~0.5pp for restructuring, which has now recurred every year FY22-FY26. D&A 4.3% in FY26 (Q1-26 carried accelerated depreciation), 3.8% thereafter (Q2/Q3-26 run-rate 3.9%). Capex 3.5% FY26-28 (9M-26 3.6%; FY26 guide $125-150m; ~$200m multi-year Hyderabad plant opening 2027), then 3.0%. Cash tax 24% on EBIT (FY25 cash tax paid $134.8m; 9M-26 GAAP ETR 23.9%). Working capital: receivables exceed payables and deferred revenue is shrinking, so growth consumes cash: wc_capture -10% of the revenue increase. VINTAGE OVERLAP, noted and not adjusted (same treatment as the prior build): cash and share count are at 2026-09-30 / 2026-10-30 while FY2026 is projected in full, so ~$246m of 9M-26 owner FCF (~$3.5/share) is in both the flows and the balance sheet; against that, every flow is discounted as if the valuation date were 2025-12-31, which understates value by most of a year's time value (roughly 3x the overlap). The net errs low. It disappears when fy0 rolls to FY2026 at the 10-K.
inputs.net_debt_basis: Cash $1,144.9m at 2026-09-30 less the $30m of October 2026 repurchases already reflected in the 2026-10-30 share count = $1,114.9m. No debt, no marketable securities.

bear.narrative: With the SmartTrack materials patents held invalid, Spark, ClearCorrect/Smartee and Angelalign take the value end; North America adult retail stays soft, iTero keeps shrinking (Systems & Services already -8-9% in FY26) and FY27 revenue is flat; Align defends volume with price (revenue per case already -2.4% in Q3-26), a first-time outsider CEO resets the cost base without restoring growth, and adj EBITDA drifts to ~21.5% while SBC stays elevated to retain talent.

base.narrative: FY26 lands on the cut guide ($4.11-4.13bn, +2.1%) with owner FCF near $400m; FY27 growth restarts slowly (+3%) off a Q4-26 exit rate that is down year on year, then mid-single digits as international, teen and DSO case volumes (+6-7%) outrun falling revenue per case and a shrinking scanner line; margin rebuilds to ~26% adj EBITDA as one-offs and the deferred-revenue unwind roll off.

bull.narrative: The Q3-26 North America orthodontist uptick proves to be the turn: clear aligners resume share-taking from wires and brackets, APAC/EMEA volumes stay double-digit, teen/DSO channels and AI ClinCheck widen the funnel; the incoming CEO and the Elliott-prompted operating-model review take out structural cost, returning adj EBITDA to the 29% of FY2019/FY2021.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: UNCHANGED at 25/50/25 from the 2026-09-25 build, deliberately. Bear 25% (vs the 15% house default): revenue has been flat at $3.7-4.1bn for five years, core materials patents have been held invalid, North America demand is soft and a first-time outsider CEO takes over mid-review, so the share-erosion path is live. Base 50%: the company's guide extended at the category's growth rate. Bull 25% (vs 35%): it needs a volume re-acceleration, ASP stability and a cost reset to all go right after four years without growth. The October guidance cut is carried in the year-1 and year-2 drivers of every scenario and the accrued legal/VAT charges in the bridge; raising the bear weight as well would charge the same news twice. The CEO transition and Elliott's involvement widen the outcomes in both directions rather than shifting the mean. What would move the weights: FY2027 guidance from the new CEO (a guide below +2% or a withdrawn margin target moves bear to 30-35%), a damages-bearing outcome on the City Smiles remand, or two more quarters of North America growth (bull back toward 30%). Balance sheet risk is nil (no debt, $1.1bn cash), which is why bear is not higher.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
